note: No public ArcGIS REST service or downloadable parcel file for Brown County KS (FIPS 20013) found after searching ArcGIS Hub/Online, the county site, ORKA and vendor pages. The county points to the ORKA viewer and a Parcel Search login page, with no public REST endpoint. ORKA's only public ArcGIS layer is a 105-feature county status layer, not parcels. Wisconsin Brown County services were excluded as the wrong state. Parcel data is sold only by commercial vendors.
